schemaNotes.status: Accuracy/versioning status of the fact's VALUE itself: current | historical | deprecated | corrected-error | unresolved. Does NOT describe whether a dated event is upcoming or past.
schemaNotes.eventStatus: Present only on facts describing a specific dated event. Temporal status derived by comparing the event date to the project date: upcoming | historical. Independent from `status` — a fact can be the current, correct value (status: current) while the event it describes has already happened (eventStatus: historical).
